title: Spectra and Support Theory for Wide Subcategories in $n$-Abelian Categories
summary: We develop a support theory for wide subcategories of essentially small Krull--Schmidt \(n\)-abelian categories. We construct spectra associated with families of wide subcategories and establish the corresponding support and radical theories. In particular, we characterize prime wide subcategories as the completely meet-irreducible elements of the lattice of wide subcategories and prove that every wide subcategory is recovered from the prime wide subcategories containing it.
